asr.full_text: In the relentless pursuit of speed every detail counts introducing the all-new Polygon Helios a UCI approved race bike developed and tested with the The helios frame is 180g lighter, 32% stiffer and 50% more compliant than before, delivering instant power transfer for every sprint, climb and corner. Reinforced front and rear ends and a robust T47 bottom bracket means all you need is just a few steps in order to deliver direct power transfer. for every sprint, climb, and corner Reinforced front and rear ends and a robust T47 bottom bracket meantime all your Watts go straight to the pedals efficiently and reliably The new forward geometry with 10mm longer reach and 15mm lower stack puts you in a race ready position. Incredibly versatile, the new Helios fits up to 34 seat tyres, and allows you to swap between an aero seat post and a more compliant 27.2 Millimetre round seat post for extra comfort. The semi-integrated carbon cockpit allows you to swap stems easily and get your fit dialled. carbon cockpit allows you to swap stems easily and get your fit dialed. Dual bottle cage mounts let you choose your hydration setup without sacrificing performance. Finished with Link carbon wheels, UDH compatibility and bold new colors. The Helios is ready to ride today and race tomorrow. Ready for your next breakaway? Discover the new Polygon Helios A at your local dealer or online. in-line.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents the Polygon Helios A bicycle through studio and riding footage, along with descriptions of its frame, geometry, and components. Its actionable message is ordinary retail promotion through a local dealer or online, rather than a request for investment, unusual returns, credentials, or other financial participation. The performance figures are product claims, but the available video evidence does not establish any transaction outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary retail product promotion: it introduces the Polygon Helios A, describes bicycle components and features, shows the bicycle in studio and riding footage, and directs viewers to a dealer or online source.
